patch_description: Add a complementary CRZ gate on [5,0] using the shared "ent_lr" parameter to create wrap-around diagonal connectivity. This enriches the long-range entangler with complementary patterns that improve gradient signals and hard-sample discrimination without increasing distinct parameters. The gate connects qubit 5 back to qubit 0, completing a wrap-around diagonal pattern alongside the existing [0,3], [1,4], [2,5], [3,6], [4,7] gates. This should sharpen the worst-group margin by providing better connectivity for disentangling hardest samples.
